description: Free to call. Buys the full security report for an agent you own, paying by on-chain transfer rather than x402 — which is the only way to pay in CENTRY. Call get_report_price first for the amount and the address, transfer it on Base, then call this with the tx hash. Paying in CENTRY is cheaper than USDC; the discount is in the price quote. The alternative is get_agent_report, which charges USDC per call over x402 and cannot accept CENTRY.

agent_id.description: The agent's UUID. You must own it.

payment_token.description: CENTRY or USDC. Defaults to USDC.

payment_tx_hash.description: Hash of the CENTRY or USDC transfer.

signed_message.description: The exact message that was signed.

wallet.description: The owning wallet, 0x-prefixed. Must match the signature.

name: purchase_report
title: Buy a full report with CENTRY or USDC
